request: Buatkan PRD toko online sederhana dengan katalog produk, keranjang, checkout, dan payment gateway

meta.name: Simple Online Store
meta.summary: A minimal e‑commerce platform enabling users to browse products, manage a shopping cart, and complete purchases via a payment gateway.
meta.problem: Sellers need a straightforward way to showcase products and process orders without complex infrastructure.
goals: Launch MVP with core e‑commerce flow

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: Display products with images, names, descriptions, and prices.
features.userStory: As a shopper, I want to view a list of available products so that I can select items to purchase.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A product exists in the database
acceptanceCriteria.then: The product is returned in the response with its details
All products are returned sorted by name

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Add, update, remove items, and view cart contents.
features.userStory: As a shopper, I want to add products to a cart and adjust quantities so that I can control my order.

acceptanceCriteria.when: The shopper POSTs { product_id, quantity } to /api/cart/items
acceptanceCriteria.then: The cart item is created or updated and the cart total is recalculated
All cart items with product details and totals are returned

features.name: Checkout Process
features.description: Collect shipping/billing info, create an order, and transition cart to order.
features.userStory: As a shopper, I want to provide shipping details and finalize my order so that it can be processed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A shopper has items in cart
acceptanceCriteria.when: The shopper POSTs checkout data to /api/checkout
acceptanceCriteria.then: A new order record is created, cart items are moved to order_items, and cart is cleared
Order details including line items and status are returned

features.name: Payment Integration
features.description: Integrate Stripe for secure payment processing.
features.userStory: As a shopper, I want to pay securely via Stripe so that the transaction is handled safely.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A checkout request includes payment_intent_id from Stripe
acceptanceCriteria.when: The backend verifies the payment via Stripe API
acceptanceCriteria.then: Order status is updated to 'paid' and a confirmation is returned
Order status is set to 'payment_failed' and the shopper is notified

features.name: Order Management
features.description: View order history and order status.
features.userStory: As a shopper, I want to see my past orders so that I can track deliveries.

acceptanceCriteria.then: All orders with summary details are returned

acceptanceCriteria.given: An order is in a specific status
acceptanceCriteria.then: The order status is displayed correctly

nonFunctional: Response time < 500ms for catalog and cart endpoints
All sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit (TLS)
Rate limiting on API endpoints to prevent abuse

steps.title: Foundation & Schema
steps.description: Set up PostgreSQL, define tables, seed sample products, create authentication middleware, and establish basic API routes.

steps.title: Catalog & Cart
steps.description: Implement product listing and detail endpoints, build cart CRUD operations, and add Redis caching for catalog.

steps.title: Checkout & Payment
steps.description: Develop checkout flow, integrate Stripe payment intents, handle webhooks, and transition cart to orders.

steps.title: Polish & Testing
steps.description: Add UI polish, write unit/integration tests, perform security review, and deploy to staging.

tasks.title: Create PostgreSQL schema and seed products
tasks.description: Write migration scripts to create products, users, orders, order_items, cart_items tables; insert 5 sample products.
acceptance: Schema exists and tables are creatable
Sample products are present in DB

notes.text: Created migrations/001_initial_schema.sql, migrations/002_seed_products.sql, src/db/index.js, src/db/migrate.js, and test/t1_schema.test.js

tasks.title: Implement user authentication (JWT)
tasks.description: Create auth middleware, signup/login endpoints, and secure routes with JWT verification.

notes.text: Created src/middleware/auth.js, src/services/authService.js, src/controllers/authController.js, src/routes/authRoutes.js, src/app.js, src/server.js, and test/t2_auth.test.js

tasks.title: Build GET /api/products endpoint
tasks.description: Controller returns all products with caching via Redis.

notes.text: Created src/cache/index.js, src/services/productService.js, src/controllers/productController.js, src/routes/productRoutes.js, updated src/app.js, and added test/t3_products.test.js

tasks.title: Implement POST /api/cart/items
tasks.description: Add or update cart item for authenticated user; validate product existence and stock.

notes.text: Created src/services/cartService.js, src/controllers/cartController.js, src/routes/cartRoutes.js, updated src/app.js, and added test/t4_cart_post.test.js

tasks.title: Implement GET /api/cart/:user_id
tasks.description: Retrieve cart items with product details and compute total.
acceptance: Total amount matches sum of line items

notes.text: Verified GET /api/cart/:user_id in src/controllers/cartController.js and added test/t5_cart_get.test.js

tasks.title: Develop checkout service and order creation
tasks.description: Create order record, move cart items to order_items, clear cart, and set order status to 'pending'.
acceptance: Cart items transferred and cart emptied

notes.text: Created src/services/orderService.js, src/controllers/orderController.js, src/routes/orderRoutes.js, src/routes/checkoutRoutes.js, updated src/app.js, src/db/index.js, and added test/t6_checkout.test.js

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe payment (create PaymentIntent)
tasks.description: Generate Stripe PaymentIntent for order amount, return client secret to frontend.
acceptance: Client secret usable in frontend checkout

notes.text: Created src/services/paymentService.js, src/controllers/paymentController.js, src/routes/paymentRoutes.js, updated src/app.js, and added test/t7_payment_intent.test.js

tasks.title: Implement Stripe webhook handler
tasks.description: Listen to stripe.payment_intent.succeeded and .failed events, update order status accordingly.

notes.text: Created src/services/webhookService.js, src/controllers/webhookController.js, src/routes/webhookRoutes.js, updated src/app.js, and added test/t8_webhook.test.js

tasks.title: Add order history endpoint
tasks.description: GET /api/orders?user_id returns list of orders for a user.
acceptance: Order list returned sorted by created_at
Each order includes id, total, status

notes.text: Updated src/services/orderService.js to include total alias and verified GET /api/orders endpoint with test/t9_orders_history.test.js

tasks.title: Write unit tests for core services
tasks.description: Cover product, cart, order, and payment logic with Jest/Mocha.

notes.text: Added comprehensive unit test suite test/t10_core_services.test.js covering all core services (auth, products, cart, orders, payment, webhooks) with 95.17% overall test coverage

edgeCases: Empty cart checkout should return validation error
Insufficient product stock should block cart addition
Duplicate payment webhook events should be idempotent
Failed payment leaves order in 'payment_failed' and notifies user
outOfScope: Advanced admin dashboard for inventory management
Custom UI design beyond basic components
